items.title: World Mental Health Day
items.summary: 2026 theme: Lived experiences heard: real voices, real change. A strong date for a community coffee morning, open conversation or awareness event.

items.title: World Mental Health Day webinar
items.summary: WHO and partner organisations discuss meaningful involvement of people with lived experience in mental-health policy, services and practice.

items.title: National Stress Awareness Day
items.summary: A useful prompt for a stress-management, wellbeing, mindfulness or coffee-and-chat event.

items.title: Time to Talk Day
items.summary: The first Thursday in February is a useful prompt for an event centred on starting conversations about mental health.

items.title: MIND mental-health drop-in
items.summary: Oxfordshire County Council lists a MIND mental-health drop-in at Abingdon Library.

items.title: Mental Health Awareness training
items.summary: Mental Health Awareness session listed by Oxfordshire Mind.

items.title: Mental Health Awareness training
items.summary: In-person Mental Health Awareness session listed by Oxfordshire Mind.

items.title: Suicide First Aid Lite
items.summary: Suicide First Aid Lite session listed by Oxfordshire Mind.

items.title: Oxford Half Marathon for Oxfordshire Mind
items.summary: Oxford Half Marathon supporting better mental health in Oxfordshire. Charity places were full when checked, with a waitlist available.

items.title: Mental Elf 5k Run
items.summary: Oxfordshire Mind lists Mental Elf 5k among its 2026 events and fundraising opportunities.

items.title: NHFT Annual Public and Members' Meeting
items.summary: Open public meeting including an update on Thriving in Life, a new health and wellbeing service for 11–19-year-olds in North Northamptonshire.

items.title: Northamptonshire Mind groups & peer support
items.summary: Current programme includes peer support, men's groups, mindfulness, walking, music and singing, art and other wellbeing groups. Check the current programme before attending.

items.title: Fully funded mental-health and suicide first-aid training
items.summary: Buckinghamshire Mind and Buckinghamshire Council are offering funded MHFA and Suicide First Aid training to eligible community, charity and public-sector staff and volunteers during 2026–2027.

items.title: Peer Support Bucks
items.summary: Community-based social and activity groups for adults in Buckinghamshire who are in recovery from mental ill-health. Current timetable is available from Bucks Mind.
